overview_text: The computer science and English combined major focuses on the increasingly interdisciplinary processes of creating, interpreting, and analyzing texts and programs. Students will combine communication and critical judgment, gaining the creativity and adaptability necessary to utilize technology in literary studies, and apply humanities skills to solve programming problems.
